title: SAVA R21 Gelaro S6/S4 long-term review
notes: The author reports more than 1,800 km on the R21 S4/S6 platform and describes no noticeable bottom-bracket-area flex while climbing, useful stay compliance on washboard, stable descending, and slower acceleration attributable to the heavy wheels. This is qualitative ride evidence, not a measured stiffness test. The page describes T700 UD and press-fit construction, which conflicts with the current exact S4 manufacturer page's T800 and BBT47 specification and is treated as an older or mismatched report rather than a correction.
